info.name: VaultX API Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman test collection for VaultX API. Covers all CRUD endpoints for Users, Wallets, and Transactions, plus System endpoints. Built for QA interns following the VaultX API Docs v1.0.0.

**Base URL variable**: Set `baseUrl` to `https://vault-api-dhun.onrender.com` for staging or `http://localhost:4000` for local.

**Always run**: POST /api/reset before starting a new test session.
